title: Reimbursement Claim Periods by FBN Program
content:
The waits and windows that govern Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) reimbursements are counted in calendar days. Each is counted from the event named in its row.

| Period (calendar days) | Counted from | FBN Starter Program | FBN Core Program | FBN Growth Program | FBN Scale Program | FBN Premier Program | FBN Enterprise Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inbound reconciliation wait | the shipment line's last receipt | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Inbound shortage claim window | the shipment line's last receipt | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Automatic reimbursement after | a lost or damaged-in-warehouse adjustment | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Warehouse loss claim window | a lost or damaged-in-warehouse adjustment | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Customer return not received, wait | the buyer refund | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Customer return not received, claim window | the buyer refund | 105 | 105 | 105 | 105 | 105 | 105 |
| Lost removal shipment claim window | the removal order's creation | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

## Notes

- Every period has the same length in all six programs.
- A wait is a number of days that must pass before a claim may be filed; a window is the number of days within which it may be filed.
- Illustration (hypothetical dates): a buyer refund on 1 March reaches the 45-day wait on 15 April and the 105-day window on 14 June.
